prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description:
The system replaces {data} in the prompt with the segment text and sends it to the AI model.
Ask the model to wrap each generated question in {questionTags} so the system can relate it to the segment.
You can adjust the prompt or choose another model to improve the results.
prompt.defaultValue:
Content: {data}

Summarize the content above and use the summary to generate 5 questions.
Output requirements:
- Output only the questions.
- Wrap each question in {questionTags}.
